## NYT::NFlow::TUnitedParameters&lt;NYT::NFlow::TAtLeastOnceKafkaSink&gt; {#NYT_NFlow_TUnitedParameters_NYT_NFlow_TAtLeastOnceKafkaSink}

|| **Parameter** | **Description** ||
|| `topic` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Required parameter**
Name of the Kafka topic. ||
|| `payload_column` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Default value**: `data`
Input column whose bytes become the record value. A null value is written as a Kafka null value, which is a tombstone in a compacted topic. ||
|| `key_column` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Default value**: `TString("")`
Input column whose bytes become the record key; librdkafka chooses the partition by the key. An empty name or a null value means no key, and librdkafka spreads such records across partitions. ||
|| `message_id_header` | **Type**: `std::string`
**Default value**: `TString("")`
Name of a record header carrying the Flow message ID. The ID is preserved when the asynchronous sink replays a message, but may change on recomputation for the synchronous sink. An empty string disables the header. ||
